phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F2 Phase A1 — Deposit Submatrix Coverage Audit
scope: Deposits only; total F2 remains out of scope.

domestic_issuer_reconciliation.rule: H and C are structural non-issuers of deposits under ESA 2010; resident issuer columns F, G and BNR reconcile to W0 liabilities, and the published C liability aggregate confirms zero.

external_asset_gap.interpretation: The residuals are not allocated or promoted as external deposit values. They identify the magnitude of the incomplete row reconciliation while the official external-source bridge remains unresolved.

official_framework.esa_2010: Deposits F22/F29 are liabilities of deposit-taking corporations and, in some cases, central government; non-resident institutional units may also be debtors.
official_framework.external_statistics_candidate: ECB/Eurostat BOP-IIP Other Investment / Currency and Deposits by resident institutional sector
official_framework.external_statistics_limitation: BOP/IIP sector granularity and BPM6-vs-ESA instrument conventions must be reconciled before any QSA Accounting Spine cell is populated.

next_gate.name: External Deposit Asset Source Reconciliation
next_gate.task: Test ECB BPS / Eurostat BOP-IIP / BNR external-sector series for H, C, F, G and BNR claims on non-residents in currency and deposits, reconcile sector definitions and BPM6/ESA conventions, and compare independently with the ten QSA row residuals.
next_gate.promotion_rule: Only exact observed or exact definitionally justified derived external values that reconcile to QSA W0 controls may close the X issuer column. Residual allocation by construction is prohibited.
